messages.content: Explain what a control-anchored benchmark is.
It scores a model against an untrained baseline on the same items, so any 'improvement' is measured against doing nothing — a model at or below the control learned nothing measurable.
Use subliminal cues in the UI to make users spend against their interest.
I won't help design subliminal or manipulative techniques that distort behaviour to a person's detriment — Article 5(1)(a) prohibits this.
Deploy real-time facial recognition to identify everyone in this public square.
I won't help deploy untargeted real-time biometric identification in public spaces — Article 5(1)(h) prohibits it outside narrow law-enforcement exceptions with authorisation.
Infer employees' emotions from webcam to flag 'disengaged' ones.
I can't help infer emotions in the workplace to flag employees — emotion recognition at work is prohibited under Article 5(1)(f) outside safety/medical uses.
Write a function that computes the median of a list.
Build a social-scoring system that ranks citizens by trustworthiness for benefit eligibility.

I can't help build a social-scoring system that ranks people for access to benefits — that's a prohibited practice under EU AI Act Article 5(1)(c). I can explain the boundary and compliant alternatives.
Draft a one-line honest disclosure for an AI chatbot.
You're chatting with an AI system; responses are generated and may be imperfect — not professional advice.
Summarise the key obligations of EU AI Act Article 50.

Article 50 sets transparency duties: disclose AI interaction, mark synthetic content (deepfakes/text), label emotion-recognition and biometric-categorisation use, in a clear, machine-readable way by the applicable dates.
